summary: The filing reports RPM International's amendment of its existing $300 million accounts receivable securitization facility. Amendments include removing the SOFR credit spread adjustment, eliminating the interest coverage ratio covenant, and adding a leverage ratio covenant (≤3.75x) that applies when the company lacks investment-grade ratings from two agencies. The threshold for judgment-based and material-indebtedness amortization events was increased. This is a routine financing amendment with no special-situation event; no deal terms, premiums, or change-of-control elements are present.
